acolyte_a: Pell: The heat in here makes Spirlings restless.
acolyte_a_intro: Pell: Only those who pass us may face the Warden!
acolyte_a_defeat: Pell: Go on, then. Orrin waits at the core.
acolyte_b: Suri: Orrin has guarded this Rift for years.
acolyte_b_intro: Suri: My Kindlop runs hot. Ready?
acolyte_b_defeat: Suri: Cooled off... just like that.

lines: Orrin: The Cinder Rift is calm. The way north from Thornridge is open to you.

orrin_intro: Warden Orrin: You came all this way through the heat.
Then show me the bond you share with your team!
orrin_defeat: Warden Orrin: That's a real bond.
I'll let the Rift close. Take that strength north.
